purpose: Normalize near-duplicate semantic tags across LOC3/LOC4/LOC5 for cross-period comparison while preserving named concepts as separate dimensions.
rules: Named concepts are never collapsed into generic semantic families.
微月光 is a named concept and is explicitly excluded from 光月意象.
Raw source tags remain evidence; normalized families are the comparison/display layer.
LOC3/LOC4 own source semantics; LOC7 owns this normalization structure; LOC8 provides temporal grouping.

families.label: 光月意象
families.note: 泛指光、微光、月亮與月光的視覺意象；不包含 LOC3 專有名詞「微月光」。
